{{Otheruses|Black Team}}
'''Black Team''' was a unit of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]] assigned to [[Operation Cobolt]]. They were assigned to sabotage the [[Imperial orbital base|orbital base's]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. Black Team was overwhelmed by enemy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during the operation.
